mezz_config.config.screen.allMods.title: All Mods
mezz_config.config.screen.allMods.info: Open the list of config screens for all mods.
mezz_config.config.screen.resize.title: Resize
mezz_config.config.screen.resize.info: Drag a screen edge or corner to resize it. The window size is saved when released.
mezz_config.config.screen.list.title: Config Screens

mezz_config.config.screen.apply.gameRest: Save pending changes and close the config screen. These changes take effect after restarting the game.

mezz_config.config.screen.restart.nextGa: %s changes were saved and will be applied the next time the game is started.
mezz_config.config.screen.discard.info: Discard pending config changes and close the screen.
mezz_config.config.screen.back.info: Return to the config screen without applying or discarding changes.

mezz_config_gui.config.screen.title: MezzConfig GUI Options
mezz_config_gui.config.appearance.descri: Controls the size and density of MezzConfig GUI screens.
mezz_config_gui.config.appearance.guiMod: Choose between a centered window and the full game window.
Use the configured window width and height.
Use the full game window for config screens.
mezz_config_gui.config.appearance.enable: Allow config screens, including the Mods screen, to be resized by dragging an edge or corner.
mezz_config_gui.config.appearance.window: Width of windowed config screens. Dragging a screen edge updates this value.
Height of windowed config screens. Dragging a screen edge updates this value.
mezz_config_gui.config.appearance.rowDen: Controls the amount of vertical spacing used by config value rows.
mezz_config_gui.config.appearance.number: Choose how bounded number values are displayed on newly opened config screens.
Use Minecraft-style slider bars for bounded integer and decimal values.
Use editable text, stepper buttons, or compact selections as appropriate.
mezz_config_gui.config.appearance.showRo: Alternate value row backgrounds between slightly lighter and darker colors.
mezz_config_gui.config.appearance.showAd: Show stable names, apply mode, restart flags, serializers, and editor ids in value info.
mezz_config_gui.config.navigation.descri: Controls search and category navigation behavior.
mezz_config_gui.config.navigation.rememb: Return to the last selected category for each mod during this game session.
mezz_config_gui.config.navigation.search: Include config value descriptions when filtering search results.
mezz_config_gui.config.navigation.focusS: Put keyboard focus in the search box when a config screen opens.
mezz_config_gui.config.scrolling.descrip: Controls mouse wheel scrolling and drag auto-scroll behavior.
mezz_config_gui.config.scrolling.smoothS: Animate scroll position changes instead of jumping immediately.
mezz_config_gui.config.scrolling.scrollS: Controls how far the config screen scrolls for each mouse wheel step.
mezz_config_gui.config.scrolling.dragAut: Controls how quickly list rows auto-scroll while dragging near the edge.
mezz_config_gui.config.editing.descripti: Controls how edits are confirmed and how list values can be reordered.
mezz_config_gui.config.editing.confirmPe: Ask whether to save or discard pending changes when closing a config screen.
mezz_config_gui.config.editing.enableDra: Allow list rows to be reordered by dragging. Up and down buttons still work when this is disabled.
mezz_config_gui.config.integrations.desc: Controls integration behavior with Minecraft and platform-specific config systems.
mezz_config_gui.config.integrations.show: Automatically add a mod's key mappings to its config screen when possible.
Show conflict highlighting and conflict details for key mappings.
mezz_config_gui.config.advanced.descript: Controls troubleshooting and platform discovery behavior.
mezz_config_gui.config.advanced.enableNa: Automatically create config screens for supported platform-native config files.
mezz_config_gui.config.advanced.discover: Controls extra logging for config screen and plugin discovery.
Do not log extra discovery details.
Use normal warning and error logging.
